title: Smoke de navegador del candidate texto → audio sin generar audio
mission: Open the public generic text-to-audio candidate in a representative interactive browser and verify the visible/UI contract without triggering TTS generation. Confirm render, six voices, 1800-character counter/limit, disabled/enabled generate control, and that page load sends no POST generation request.
definition_of_done: The public candidate renders its candidate marker, text area, six voice choices and generate/load control in a representative browser.
The character counter and 1800-character limit behave as declared.
Network observation confirms no POST generation occurs on page load or merely changing text/voice.
No generate button click is required; no user/synthetic text is sent to TTS for this smoke.
Any browser/network boundary is recorded exactly without promoting Current/Human Accepted/Served.
